structured_output.summary: For 2026, Louisiana R.S. 47:297.8(A)(2) gives a credit of 5% of the federal EITC, and subsection (B) makes it refundable. The household files jointly with two qualifying children. Its earned income (wages plus self-employment income less half of SE tax, about $21,896) is above the $18,290 earned income amount and below the $31,160 joint phase-out threshold, so the federal EITC is the $7,316 maximum under Rev. Proc. 2025-32. 5% × $7,316 = $365.80, which is what the engine computed. The repeal bills (2025 SB 149 and HB 642, and 2026 HB 253, which would have repealed the income tax) were never enacted. No child care expenses are listed, so the other refundable Louisiana credits are $0. The consensus answer of 0 wrongly assumes Louisiana has no refundable EITC.
